arguments.code:
# Send money back to Robert for the last accidental approved payment request.

# Login tokens
pw_list = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
phone_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='phone'][0]
venmo_pw = [x['password'] for x in pw_list if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]

phone_token = apis.phone.login(username='2738013302', password=phone_pw)['access_token']
venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username='ta.weav@gmail.com', password=venmo_pw)['access_token']

# Resolve Robert from phone contacts (authoritative)
contacts = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query='Robert', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    contacts.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

rob_matches = [c for c in contacts if c.get('first_name')=='Robert']
if not rob_matches:
    raise Exception('Robert not found in phone contacts')
robert_email = rob_matches[0].get('email')
print('robert_email', robert_email)

# Fetch all approved sent payment requests and filter to Robert
approved_reqs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    resp = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, query='', status='approved', page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if not resp:
        break
    approved_reqs.extend(resp)
    page_index += 1

reqs_to_robert = [r for r in approved_reqs if ((r.get('receiver') or {}).get('email') == robert_email)]
if not reqs_to_robert:
    raise Exception('No approved sent payment requests found for Robert')

# last by approved_at then created_at
reqs_to_robert_sorted = sorted(
    reqs_to_robert,
    key=lambda r: (r.get('approved_at') or '', r.get('created_at') or ''),
    reverse=True
)
last_req = reqs_to_robert_sorted[0]
amount = last_req.get('amount')
print('last_payment_request', {'payment_request_id': last_req.get('payment_request_id'), 'amount': amount, 'approved_at': last_req.get('approved_at')})

# Check balance
balance_resp = apis.venmo.show_venmo_balance(access_token=venmo_token)
print('current_balance', balance_resp.get('venmo_balance'))

# Create transaction (send money back)
note = 'Refund for accidental Venmo payment request'
create_resp = apis.venmo.create_transaction(receiver_email=robert_email, amount=amount, access_token=venmo_token, description=note)
print('create_transaction_resp', create_resp)

transaction_id = create_resp.get('transaction_id')

# Verify transaction
tx = apis.venmo.show_transaction(transaction_id=transaction_id, access_token=venmo_token)
print('verified_transaction', {'transaction_id': tx.get('transaction_id'), 'amount': tx.get('amount'), 'receiver_email': (tx.get('receiver') or {}).get('email')})
